CREORDICS

The thermodynamic foundations of order creation

A research initiative exploring how complex systems—from cells to societies—create order through fundamental thermodynamic principles. We're building a network of scientists to investigate the universal patterns governing energy, information, and organization.

Recent advances in non-equilibrium thermodynamics suggest a unifying principle underlying all self-organizing systems. From Prigogine's dissipative structures to Bejan's constructal law, evidence points toward a deeper pattern waiting to be formalized.

Core Research Questions

  • How do systems optimize exergy extraction across multiple scales?
  • What role does consciousness play in accelerating entropy production?
  • Can we quantify the thermodynamic efficiency of decision-making processes?
  • How does information processing relate to gradient exploitation in living systems?
  • What are the fundamental limits of order creation in finite-energy environments?

About the Initiative

Founded by Ethan Jon, an entrepreneur and systems thinker with 15+ years in technology and a passion for understanding complex systems. This initiative combines rigorous scientific inquiry with practical applications across disciplines.

Our initial focus: developing a mathematical framework that unifies existing theories while making testable predictions about system behavior and evolution.
